text:
Jordan Park: Quick preflight for v0.24.0 GH release — ownership check and tiny checklist before cutoff (5pm PT). Who will push the annotated tag? Who's publishing the draft release and attaching artifacts? Need signed checksums visible in the release body. CI is green but want a quick confirm.

Meera Singh: I can push the annotated tag. I have my GPG key imported on the release runner. Confirm final commit hash to tag is 3a9f2b1.

Sasha Liu: I can create the draft release and upload assets to the GH release (after tag exists). Please make sure artifacts are staged in s3://redwood-releases/v0.24.0/ so I can grab them.

Daniel O'Connor: Uploaded artifacts to s3 (linux-amd64, linux-arm64, darwin). Also uploaded .asc sigs to the same path. Checksums below: ```
3a9f2b1  linux-amd64.tar.gz  sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924
3a9f2b1  linux-arm64.tar.gz  sha256: 5f70bf18a08660b3b8f1c1f0c8f6f4f9
```
(Those are the checksums that will go in the release body)

release-bot: CI · build/17688 passed — all artifact uploads present in artifacts bucket.

Meera Singh: Tag command I'll run (once everyone confirms hash):
```
git tag -a v0.24.0 3a9f2b1 -m "v0.24.0 — release notes"
git push origin v0.24.0
```
I'll push from my machine at ~16:50 PT unless someone objects.

Sasha Liu: After tag is live I'll create the draft and attach the tarballs + .asc files and paste checksums in the body. I will *not* publish until Jordan says go. I will add the changelog link (/changelog/v0.24.0) in the body.

Jordan Park: Quick checklist for final: [ ] annotated tag pushed, [ ] draft release created, [ ] artifacts attached + checksums, [ ] release notes link, [ ] final publish approval. If anything blocks ping here.

Daniel O'Connor: One small note — linux-amd64 built on ubuntu20 has known glibc caveat, added a short note in the draft body so support teams can triage.

Meera Singh: Tag pushed. :shipit:

Sasha Liu: Draft created and assets attached. Draft URL (private): https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v0.24.0 (draft).

Jordan Park: LGTM. Plan to publish at 17:10 PT. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.

Sasha Liu: Publishing now per Jordan.

release-bot: Release published — v0.24.0 is live. Congratulations! :tada:
